envelope.description: Commit or recover the managed update transaction

body.title: Commit or recover the managed update transaction
body.summary: Use the journal to commit, roll back or retain a recovery fence. Verify candidate job removal and predecessor restoration, atomically write one outcome, and allow post-commit recovery to finish activation without rollback.
acceptanceChecks: Failed hello after registration removes only the verified candidate job before restoring the prior release
Controller loss before commit rolls back only with verified ownership; loss after commit preserves the selected release
Unresolved ownership remains fenced and a terminal outcome appears only after the verified decision

tests.name: Incompatible supervisor version produces one terminal failure after reconciliation
Terminal outcome and marker ordering, including persistence failure
Recovery applies only the operations permitted by the matching outcome
Rollback after legacy stop but before managed readiness restores the saved service
Fail hello after candidate job registration before child start, remove the candidate job and restore the prior release
Kill the controller at reservation, job registration, probation, and after outcome publication
Relaunch supervisor after provisional release selection and verify recovery restores the old selector before uncommitted rollback, or preserves the candidate after success
